field_exchange_kin.why: The exchange off midnight, first answer: hours 0 and 1 one kin group, so the rank at 00:00 takes 01:00, minute 0 on the other hour of its kin group, and no rank is exchanged.

field_exchange_put_back.why: PUT BACK once more after the exchange: the heap at minute 0 counting 2, the rest 3, hours 0 and 1 one kin group. The pass moves one rank of the pair at 00:20 onto 00:00, held; the exchange takes it off midnight to 01:00, one value too many; PUT BACK merges the rank at 00:00 onto 01:00, its kin group's, and the count of different values is the one drawn.

field_exchange_stays.why: The exchange off midnight where none can be made: a rank the pass left at 00:00, minute 0 a heap; the one rank alone in the rest, at 02:33, has no free place of minute 0 on its own hour, 02:00 being held, so the rank stays at midnight.

field_exchange_swap.why: The exchange off midnight: the rank the pass left at 00:00 takes 00:01, of the rest, and the rank alone at 02:33, of the rest, takes 02:00, the free place of minute 0 on its own hour: every group keeps its count.

field_floor.why: A draw laid on a drawing unit of an hour: floored where the floor is inside the gap, the next hour where the floor falls below it, the draw itself where no hour lies inside.

field_kin_blocked.why: KIN SHARES' carry reconciled against what each kin group holds (the Codex review of landing 3b.4, item 3): four daily gaps of 120 stamps, hours 8 and 9 each with minute 20 at seconds 0 to 29 and minute 40 at 30 to 59, each gap from 07:50 to 10:00 but the second's from 08:10; minutes 0, 20 and 40 owed 240, 120 and 120. In the second gap hour 8 can stand on no minute 0, so the gap's own moves take its share from hour 9; carried as given, both balances stood at nought and hour 8 ended with 90 on minute 0 to hour 9's 150. Reconciled, hour 8 carries the share it did not hold and takes it in the two gaps after: 120 each.

field_kin_carry.why: KIN SHARES carried from gap to gap (the lane's skeptic, item 4): four days, each a gap of two ranks in hour 8 and two in hour 9, minute 0 a heap counting one a day. Each hour is owed half a place a day; rounded gap by gap, the tie went to the rest for hour 8 and hour 9 took the heap every day. Carried, hour 8 is owed a whole place on the second day, so the two hours take it on alternate days.

field_kin_no_split.why: KIN SHARES never split a written unit a kin group's rank shares (the lane's skeptic, item 5): a heap at minute 0 counting 1, hours 8 and 9 kin groups of their own, each holding two ranks tied on one minute. Owed half a place each, the tie goes to the rest for hour 8 and hour 9 is owed the heap, but neither rank at 09:40 may leave the unit it shares by a move changing the count; the gap's own single moves then take the nearest, 08:10 to 08:00. Split within its kin group, 09:40 took 09:00.

field_kin_shares.why: KIN SHARES: a heap at minute 0 counting 2, the rest 6, hours 8 and 9 kin groups of their own. The six movable ranks stand four in hour 8 and two in hour 9, so each hour takes one of the heap's two: 08:02 takes 08:00 and 09:40 takes 09:00. Nearest first over the whole gap, both came from hour 8.

field_midnight_kin.why: No step puts a rank onto a written midnight where the pass keeps its cells there (the lane's skeptic, item 1): 85 days, each with one rank at 00:17, a pair at 05:00 and ranks at 06:20 and 06:40, one kin group, minute 0 a heap counting the pairs and one rank more a day, the count at midnight published. A written midnight is a kind of its own, so the rank at 06:20 takes 06:00 and the rank at 00:17 stays. Kept by no kind, the nearer 00:17 took 00:00 on all 85 days; the exchange, asking 64 runs at most, took 64 back to 00:01, and 21 stayed at midnight.

field_midnight_narrow.why: The tails keep the count at midnight in a stratum narrower than the drawing unit: three ranks at a written midnight where two are published; the tail rank at one, rank 3, drawn on the hour, has 46 minutes after it and none before, so it steps one written unit, a minute, later.

field_midnight_room.why: The tails make room at midnight: a column on the hour, minute 0 a heap counting the four body ranks, the count at midnight published. The hour pass left rank 2 at 00:01, whose only place on minute 0 is the day's midnight, which no step moves a rank onto; the low tail's rank at a midnight steps an hour off it inside its stratum, and rank 2 takes 00:00 of its own day -- the count at midnight kept, the heap met.

field_midnight_room_keep.why: The tails make room at midnight without raising the count (the lane's second skeptic, item 3): rank 4, alone at 00:01, takes its day's midnight, and of the low tail's three ranks at a midnight the first two share one written unit, so either stepping an hour off it writes one value more; the third, alone at its midnight, steps instead and the count of different values is kept. With no such guard the first tail rank stepped and the count rose by one.

field_midnight_room_spread.why: SPREAD after the tails make room (the lane's second skeptic, item 3; the repair's 10,000-row rank at 00:01 that joined a cell already at its day's midnight): rank 2, alone at 00:01, takes its day's midnight beside rank 1, a value lost, and the tail rank's step off its own midnight keeps the count; SPREAD then moves the second of the two ranks at 05:20 to 05:19, its group's nearest free place, and the count is kept. Without SPREAD after the step the twin came back one value short.

field_midnight_share.why: KIN SHARES on a pass barring midnight: hours 0 and 1 one kin group, hours 5 and 6 another, minute 0 a heap counting 12 of the 24 movable ranks. Of the first kin group only the six ranks of hour 1 are free to take the heap, so it takes 12 x 6 / 18 = 4 places and the other kin group 8, in proportion to the ranks free to stand there.

field_midnight_short.why: The tails take a midnight where the count at midnight is short (the lane's skeptic, item 5): two ranks at a written midnight where three are published; the unpinned tail rank at 03:10, rank 1, takes the nearest midnight inside its stratum, 00:00 of its own day.

field_midnight_spread.why: KIN SHARES keeping the cells at midnight (the lane's skeptic, item 1): six days, each with a rank at 00:17, 01:05 and 05:25, hours 0, 1 and 5 kin groups of their own, minute 0 a heap counting 6 of the 18 movable ranks, the count at midnight published. Hour 0's ranks are not free to take the heap -- its minute 0 is the day's midnight -- so its share goes to hours 1 and 5 by their free ranks, three each. Shared in proportion, hour 0's two could not be taken and went to the nearest, hour 1, four against two.

field_midnight_tails.why: The tails keep the count at midnight: four ranks at a written midnight where three are published; the first unpinned tail rank at one, rank 1, steps a minute later inside its stratum.

field_midnight_zero_room.why: KIN SHARES give no kin group more of value 0 than its free ranks (the lane's second skeptic, item 3): hours 0 and 1 one kin group, 2 and 3 another, 4 to 7 a third; minute 0 a heap counting 8 of the 14 body ranks, the count at midnight published; noon of day 8 pinned, parting two gaps. In the second gap minute 0 is owed five: hours 4 to 7 take two, the one rank of hour 0 -- its place on minute 0 the day's midnight -- none, and hours 2 and 3 the other three. Given room for its rank on minute 0, hour 0's kin group took one place there by the largest remainder, which its rank cannot stand on, and hours 2 and 3 came back with two of the five.

field_minute_heaps.why: G7.3h on the minute: a heap at minute 0 counting 3, the rest 5, every rank between 08:00 and 10:59 of one day, hours 8 to 10 one kin group. Hour 9 holds one place at minute 0, so one rank takes it and the next takes 10:00, the other hour of its kin group.

field_second_zero.why: G7.3h on the second: a heap at second 0 counting 4, the rest 1, the minutes 09:10 to 09:14 one kin group. The rank at 09:11:29 takes 09:11:00 on its own minute; minute 09:10 holds its one place at second 0 at its pin, so a rank of it takes 09:12:00, second 0 on the nearest other minute of its kin group.

field_spread.why: SPREAD: one value too few. The two ranks at 09:00 share it; minute 0 on hour 9 has no other place, so the first of them takes 10:00, minute 0 on the other hour of its kin group.

field_substitute.why: SUBSTITUTE: one value too many. The rank alone at 09:00, of the heap, joins 09:20 on its own hour, of the rest; the rank alone at 14:37, of the rest, takes 14:00, the heap's free place on its own hour. Both groups keep their counts.

field_whole_unit.why: A shared written unit moves whole or not at all (the lane's second skeptic, item 1): minutes 0 to 20, 21 to 32, 33 to 53 and 54 to 59 counting 4, 5, 3 and 4 of the 16 ranks; the pair at 11:49 and the pair at 16:30 each move whole onto minute 54 of their own hour, and 12:42 to 12:32, so the nine values stay nine. Moved one rank at a time, one rank of the pair at 16:30 stayed and the twin wrote ten.

field_whole_unit_past.why: In the leftover a shared unit moves whole past its groups' room, once (the lane's second skeptic, item 1): minutes 0 to 35 owe one rank more and 36 to 58 one less, and every unit of the second is a triple. The triple at 13:40 moves whole onto 13:35, two over; the four at 09:10 and the one at 10:23 then move to minute 36 of their hours and the triple at 12:42 whole to 12:35, and both groups hold: the six values stay six. With no unit carried past its room, one rank of 13:40 moved alone and the twin wrote seven.

lattice_half_hour.why: A half-hour grid written to the minute: heaps at minutes 0 and 30 and no census, so its body is drawn on thirty minutes, 1,800 seconds.

lattice_on_the_hour_seconds.why: Written to the second, every second on 0 and every minute on 0: heaps at second 0 and at minute 0, no census, so the body is drawn on the hour.

lattice_one_group.why: One non-zero group holding minute 0 and every published value on minute 0 (the design skeptic's M2): drawn on the hour; a value off minute 0 would pin nothing.

lattice_rest_withheld.why: Heaps at minutes 0 and 30 and no census beside them, but 100 of the 283 body cells off them -- a census of the rest withheld, not a few strays (the lane's skeptic, item 2): the heaps pin nothing, and a column written to the minute is drawn as before.

lattice_seconds_only.why: Written to the second with every second on 0 and minutes on a census of the rest: the body is drawn on the minute.

tail_end.why: G7.3b step 7's END held off a midnight the count leaves it none of (the Codex review of landing 3b.4, item 4): a column on the hour owing 12 cells at midnight, 11 of them its body's for certain -- hour 0 counts 11 alone, minute 0 the whole body of 978, written to the minute. Both ENDs stand at a written midnight: the low tail's takes the one left, and the high tail's steps inward off it and off the hole the minute before names, two minutes in. Without the rule both ends stood at midnight, 13 in all.

what: The states of ranks method section G7.3h's own steps (landing 3b.4, plan P4-D372) are frozen on, and the drawing units G7.3's drawing rule gives, each with its answer computed from the method's text: every rank's ordinal after the step, every draw laid on its unit, or the unit. A state's field is the minute (`field_unit` 60, the hour its parent) or the second (1, the minute), its bins `where`, each parent's group in the coarser census `kin`; it names its census, its written unit, its day standing and its holes.
